Are you ready for a hands-on technical role where every day brings new challenges and the chance to work with cutting-edge CNC technology? Technical experience or insight in a manufacturing or production environment Willingness to work shifts (3-shift system) Own transportation (the site has limited public transport access) Fluency in Dutch, English, or German A curious, precise, and growth-oriented mindset Wat bieden wij je? €20.18 gross per hour (including allowances - see below for the breakdown) Full-time, 37.5 hours a week in 3-shift rotation Travel reimbursement Full onboarding and personal coaching to get you up to speed Chance to move to a permanent contract once you've proven yourself Room to develop yourself through training and growth opportunities A friendly, professional team with people from all over the world How does the salary work? Allround Process Operator in 2 shifts  Tussen €2.723 en €3.770 Per maand  Beschrijving Hoe ziet jouw werkdag eruit? You start your day by going through the production schedule and then flush the machines with water before starting production. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that the correct materials are ready and that the production lines are operational. Using the forklift, you ensure that all products are in the right place. You set up machines, monitor the parameters and carry out quality tests. You record and document all your findings. If you notice a deviation or a fault, you look for a solution and make adjustments where necessary. You also carry out minor technical maintenance and contribute ideas for improvements. At the end of the day, you get to work cleaning the machine so that production can start again the following day. You'll work with various machines and production lines, which keeps your work nicely varied. Step by step, as a trainee all-round process operator, you'll get to know all the processes and, within 6 to 12 months, you'll progress to become a fully-fledged All-round Process Operator. Specifically, you'll spend 25 % of your time on cleaning, 25 % on quality and parameter checks and 50 % operating the machines.
